lessonMappingReview: Real catalog lessons C5-L01 harmonic oscillators, C5-L02 propagation and C5-L05 acoustic echo were read; C1-L003 instantaneous motion, C1-L005 Newton and C1-L006 linear spring provide the real mechanics transfer. Course C5, individual skills and prerequisite lists and C6 reuse were checked against the actual candidate edition.
limitations: Only assigned ideal models are verified; actual media may disperse or flow, echoes may include delays or changing paths, and real springs may damp or depart from linear elasticity.
Literal signatures bind exactly the prose read; arbitrary future prose is not semantically parsed.
Exact alternatives use a bounded rational, decimal, pi or integer-radical monomial grammar and the reviewed unit suffix. Arbitrary expressions and functions are rejected.

Rebound keys, units, sources, equivalent choices and figure scales are rejected after test-only replacement of tokens and edition hashes. The plausible false prose case is rejected by frozen reading, not a general natural-language proof checker.
AI_CONCEPTUAL remains distinct from EXACT_ORACLE. Human approval is NOT_RUN; all drafts remain DRAFT.

primaryBeforeKeys: Differentiate harmonic displacement to obtain v=−Aω sin(ωt+φ). Its maximal modulus is Aω, attained at equilibrium, with zero speed at the endpoints. Angular frequency is distinct from ordinary frequency.

propertyAudit.coverage: Wave advance per period; reciprocal echo path and constant speed; Newton harmonic reduced period; velocity and acceleration derivatives, endpoint signs, inverse physical roots, nonlinear means, affine displays and continuous scale freedom. Fresh and saved reading identity against actual package and bindings.

records.assetReview: Position origin x=320 at 60 px/m gives endpoints x=200 and x=440 for −2 and +2 m. Three distinct instants show rest at the right endpoint and two separate passages through equilibrium. Each velocity arrow is 120 px at 20 px/(m/s), giving oriented velocities ±6 m/s. Phase graph origin (100,900), 200/π px/rad and 20 px/(m/s): the −6 sinθ curve has minimum (200,1020), zero (300,900), maximum (400,780) and final zero (500,900). All 241 samples, complete XML and full native image were read. Positive bars 240 and 160 px at 40 px/(m/s) give 6 and 4 m/s, ratio 2/3. Effective markers on each separate arrow were checked.
records.distractors: 12 uses the full endpoint separation 2 A instead of amplitude A; 3 copies angular frequency. Maximum modulus occurs at equilibrium, while the oriented velocity reaches both +6 and −6 m/s.
records.manualArithmetic: Differentiate displacement: v=−Aω sin(ωt+φ). Maximum sine modulus one gives speed maximum 2 m times 3 s⁻¹, or 6 m/s.
records.physicalAssumptions: A material point follows ideal harmonic displacement in an inertial frame, positive constant amplitude and angular frequency within each trial, arbitrary constant initial phase, no damping. The requested maximum is a positive modulus, with both oriented velocity signs during each cycle. This is material motion, not wave-shape propagation. Cross-trial amplitude-frequency constraints have explicit dimensioned coefficients; display is continuous and dimensionless.

source.reference: Differentiate x=A cos(ωt+φ) once to obtain oriented velocity, then maximize its modulus over a full cycle. Distinguish source frequency, angular frequency, endpoint separation and shape propagation speed.
